# Æion Factory

A repository template that lets coding agents work under shared instructions, checked specifications and safety guards, with Python 3 and the agent only.

Project `PROJECT-001` · mode **product** · owner Factory owner

## Goals

<a id="goal-001"></a>
### GOAL-001 Specifications are checked, never trusted (active)

A spec is data: it is parsed strictly, validated against the closed schema and gated, and a gate that could not run is unknown.

Success measure: Every spec change passes G01-G03 before it is committed; no unknown is ever reported as pass.

Requirements: [REQ-001](requirements.md#req-001), [REQ-002](requirements.md#req-002), [REQ-003](requirements.md#req-003), [REQ-004](requirements.md#req-004)

<a id="goal-002"></a>
### GOAL-002 Agents receive exact and complete context (active)

Before a change, an agent gets the obligations, rules, decisions and tests it must respect, from declared links, not from guesses.

Success measure: A change's packet holds every mandatory item, split rather than cut, and names what it could not map.

Requirements: [REQ-005](requirements.md#req-005), [REQ-006](requirements.md#req-006), [REQ-007](requirements.md#req-007)

<a id="goal-003"></a>
### GOAL-003 Evidence names the inputs it ran on (active)

A test result counts only for the specification and source tree it was produced on.

Success measure: A receipt is current only for its exact spec digest and source-tree digest.

Requirements: [REQ-008](requirements.md#req-008), [REQ-009](requirements.md#req-009)

<a id="goal-004"></a>
### GOAL-004 Documentation is derived, current and safe (active)

The cockpit, pages, diagrams and exported features come from the spec by code, and spec text never becomes markup.

Success measure: Generated files match their inputs byte for byte, and no spec value adds a heading, link or check.

Requirements: [REQ-010](requirements.md#req-010), [REQ-011](requirements.md#req-011), [REQ-012](requirements.md#req-012)

<a id="goal-005"></a>
### GOAL-005 Secrets never reach an agent session (active)

The shared guards refuse recognized secret reads before any harness runs the command.

Success measure: Every guarded harness refuses the recognized secret reads in the guard tests.

Requirements: [REQ-013](requirements.md#req-013)

<a id="goal-006"></a>
### GOAL-006 Python 3 and a coding agent are enough (active)

The factory's checks, graph, docs and diagrams need no virtual environment, browser or Node install.

Success measure: factory-tests passes with Python 3 alone; JavaScript adapter suites are reported as not run, never as passed.

Requirements: [REQ-014](requirements.md#req-014), [REQ-015](requirements.md#req-015)
